Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
Temptation of Greater Power (and Hostile Takeover): Can
Methuselahs bid more pool than they will be able to pay?
I know that for Game of Malkav and Malkavian Prank, the pool
you hold is a "wager" and doesn't come from your actual pool;
if you'd lose enough to oust you, you're just ousted and the
excess is ignored.

(though, a side note: if someone holds more pool than they have
for a Prank and the Prankster guesses right, does the Prankster
get the full amount held, or only as much as the victim actually
had? since the Prank says to gain the pool *from* the
Methuselah... you know, I think I may have asked this before.)

back to the ToGP/HT: It seems clear that you can bid with your
last pool and get yourself ousted (if you win the auction).
Can you also bid *more* than your last pool, and get yourself
ousted by winning the auction? If you do, do you get the vampire
first, and then leave the game (causing the vampire to leave the
game as well)?

Bribes: if you are scheduled to gain pool for a Bribed vote that
would reduce you to 0 otherwise, do you gain the pool soon enough
to stay alive? Bribes says "when the results of the referendum
are tallied" which is presumably sooner than, or at least no later
than, applying the effects of the vote.

thanks,

Josh

seems to encounter a new rules question at every vtes session

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Joshua Duffin <jt...@cornell.edu> wrote:
> Temptation of Greater Power (and Hostile Takeover): Can
> Methuselahs bid more pool than they will be able to pay?

For Hostile Takeover, no. You can only bid what you can pay.

For temptation, you can bid up to five over what you are
currently able to pay, by card text.

> if someone holds more pool than they have for a [Malkavian] Prank

> and the Prankster guesses right, does the Prankster
> get the full amount held, or only as much as the victim actually
> had? since the Prank says to gain the pool *from* the
> Methuselah... you know, I think I may have asked this before.)

Only as much as the Methuselah has.

> back to the ToGP/HT: It seems clear that you can bid with your
> last pool and get yourself ousted (if you win the auction).
> Can you also bid *more* than your last pool, and get yourself
> ousted by winning the auction?

No.

> If you do, do you get the vampire
> first, and then leave the game (causing the vampire to leave the
> game as well)?

Yes. (The vampire is burned, actually).

> Bribes: if you are scheduled to gain pool for a Bribed vote that
> would reduce you to 0 otherwise, do you gain the pool soon enough
> to stay alive? Bribes says "when the results of the referendum
> are tallied" which is presumably sooner than, or at least no later
> than, applying the effects of the vote.

Yes. Note that this is different than gaining pool from Voter
Captivation, which is played after the referendum.
